purpose:
Paired occlusion sensitivity of image-derived q/FK, NOT ground-truth accuracy.

RGB-D geometry is unchanged. Synthetic opaque occluder pixels remove original
depth ONLY, never clip predicted masks. A clean OpenCV prediction is used solely
to place occluders. Each method's occluded shape is compared to that method's
clean shape on the SAME source frame, with its clean camera-space base origin
held fixed. This is a missing-depth simulation, not real-occluder rejection.

archive_pair_audit.join_rule: exact source_time_ns; file sequence counter is NOT used

shape_estimator_metadata.filters: joint Kalman and initial-base average OFF; every call independent
shape_estimator_metadata.production_identical: 3D quartic+origin constraint+arc scaling+19 chords+18 sequential DH projections
shape_estimator_metadata.production_frontend_differences: multi-component Lee path ordering; mask-aware depth; no 2D fit/extrapolation
shape_estimator_metadata.missing_geometry: surviving observations only; gap parameter distance approximated by endpoint 3D chord
shape_estimator_metadata.known_synthetic_occlusion: depth availability only; does not clip segmentation prediction or skeleton

synthetic_depth_rule: Known generated occluder map invalidates depth query and neighborhood support ONLY. Never clips model mask.
base_rule: Per-method per-frame clean base origin reused for ALL occlusion variants. No rebase to surviving first point.
sequence_rule: Independent paired frames; no Kalman, no temporal/base initialization averaging.
omitted_comparator: U-Net V1 checkpoint is intentionally not bundled
occlusion_grade_note: [stripe count, requested total centerline occlusion fraction]; actual coverage is measured per frame
